name: Monk of the Sacred Mountain
summary: An immovable ascetic who trades agility for natural armor, rooted defense, damage reduction, and a supernatural vow of silence.

features.name: Iron Monk
features.summary: Gain Toughness without meeting its prerequisites and gain +1 natural armor.

features.name: Bastion Stance
features.summary: If you begin and end your turn in the same space, resist being knocked prone or forcibly moved.

features.name: Iron Limb Defense
features.summary: While remaining in place, gain +2 shield AC and CMD, or spend 1 ki for +4 until next turn.

features.name: Adamantine Monk DR 1/—
features.summary: Gain scaling damage reduction and spend 1 ki to double it until the next turn.

features.name: Vow of Silence
features.summary: While maintaining silence, gain +2 insight AC and CMD and +4 on Sense Motive, Stealth, and Perception; speaking suppresses it for 24 hours.
